findings.desc: quality-proof-self-attestation: scripts/run-proofstory-acceptance-rollout-cohort.mjs:77 constructs baseline/candidate observations by directly assigning detected, blocked, reviewRounds, costs, and a hard-coded full-3x2 quorum (lines 94-120), while materializeStory only writes and rereads those values (lines 36-74) and never runs acceptance_topology_check/pre_review_check or Codex+Claude review hosts. Consequently acceptance_rollout_report signs caller-authored simulated outcomes, so the claimed real matched cohort, seeded-defect detection, and genuine full-3x2 evidence are promised but undelivered; replace these records with outputs derived from actual gate/host receipts and reject unverified observation fields.

23-case executable proof is exact by ID/kind/sourceRef but several cases do not semantically exercise the intents they claim: A-POS-1 labels generic producer/read/lifecycle parity as CHK-001 role-guidance; A-POS-2 labels plannedActual completeness as CHK-002 real-cohort receipt; A-POS-3 labels capture-loader loading as CHK-003 bounded thresholds; A-POS-4 labels rollout mode/rollback as CHK-005 canonical docs. Likewise A-MUT-2 does not exercise docs-only/legacy/single-outcome false-block controls and A-MUT-6 does not exercise prompt-command removal/degraded-3x1/prompt-authority. The separate verificationEvidence may cover these behaviors, but the topology live-proof catalog currently attributes unrelated executed records to those intent refs, so pre_review_check PASS does not prove the declared positive/mutation semantics. Replace/rebind these catalog cases to execute the corresponding canonical checks (or split topology assertions so each case has truthful semantics), then recapture the canonical live proof and require a mutation that swaps an intent to a semantically unrelated case to fail.

docs/requirements/decisions/proofstory-acceptance-topology-and-pre-review-gates-execution-plan.md:1159 still states that the live-proof ledger binds four positive paths, while the current canonical proof and topology contain five positives (A-POS-1..A-POS-5). CHK-005 claims exact demonstrated status and its docs_check evidence does not catch this stale cardinality. Update the canonical text and strengthen the docs/contract check to assert the 5 positive / 17 mutation / 1 transcript inventory.
